reasoning: On the season so far the Lakers are the stronger team; with home court the Lakers start about 8 points better, in a game of about 231 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Lakers.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Lakers win 82 times in 100, by about 9; most games like this end between 203 and 251 total points.

analyst.text: This is a revenge spot: Utah beat the Lakers 109-97 in Los Angeles last Wednesday. The Jazz are on a back-to-back after a 116-114 loss in Dallas and are without Lauri Markkanen, Jaren Jackson Jr. and Jusuf Nurkic. Austin Reaves is out again, but Quentin Grimes has thrived in his place. The angle leans the Lakers.
